prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Reference image is the definitive polygon STICKER visual style and cast identity. Create Futbol Island story artwork with faceted angular characters, small simple rectangular black eyes, flat matte color planes, minimal shading, and a crisp thick WHITE DIE-CUT STICKER OUTLINE around each character and main prop. Small subtle sticker drop shadow, like the reference's bottom EMOTIONS/ACTIONS/LIFE MOMENTS stickers. Avoid cinematic 3D rendering, realistic grass, glossy round eyes, smooth Pixar-like faces. Use the 10–13 cast proportions from middle row. Charcoal kits and reference hair colors/styles. Simple pastel island pitch backdrop with a few flat polygon palms and waterfront shapes, supporting the narrative without detailed scenery. FORMAT: a 1024x1536 portrait sheet containing exactly THREE separate equal-height 1024x512 wide story scenes, stacked vertically. Thin horizontal white separators at y512 and y1024. Every scene comfortably contains whole heads and bodies with generous margins. No written captions, UI or slogans; only kit numbers and any explicitly requested scoreboard numerals. Story beats and cast: Cast: Luna, the central brown-haired high ponytail girl number10 in reference, and Kai, curly dark-haired boy in reference. Warm afternoon near island goal. TOP: Luna has just missed a chance, shoulders lowered, ball wide of goal; Kai nearby giving space. MIDDLE: Luna takes a breath and looks back toward play, upright ready to offer support, ball stays wide. BOTTOM: Kai stands beside Luna giving a gentle encouraging cue; Luna listens and looks toward play. Emotion subtle, supportive and credible. Luna must retain reference ponytail, brown eyes and charcoal kit.
